content:
Do not create a CLAUDE.md, and do not put project knowledge in one - decisions, architecture notes, contracts, rules, workflow guidance. All of it belongs in the memory MCP (memory_store / memory_add_rule), which loads into every session, is searchable, and is what this project exists to provide. Stated by the user on 2026-09-05 after a session edited three paragraphs of the old CLAUDE.md: "we never use it; all the memory must be inside memory mcp, not the claude md file." The file was deleted from the repo the same day (commit e8a62c0); the session hooks and the memory server carry everything it used to.

If a tool or a habit reaches for CLAUDE.md - memory_import_claude_md exists for OTHER projects that have one - the answer for this project is the memory, not a file.
title: Never write project knowledge into CLAUDE.md; memory lives in the memory MCP
